rv.q: A superbly realised staging of Lynn Nottage’s mighty play
It’s a testament to Lynn Nottage’s script, which premiered off-Broadway in 2016, that it carries its resonances so powerfully and explores its issues in a way that doesn’t feel strained.
Bowman’s production is punctuated by little bursts of techno music care of composer Patricia Panther.

cn.t: This American rust belt drama proves unexpectedly universal on a Scottish stage, with critics praising its resonance beyond its specific setting, though some initially question the transatlantic transplant.
